content: Tɨratu kememɨte'uhekwariyaxɨ
Muitsexi 'ixaheritsixi Muhawi kwieyaritsie mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe, 'imatɨrieka tɨratu hepaɨtsita Yawé yati'aitɨakaku, metatsiere meripaitɨri tɨratu muwewiekai Huré mɨrakutewatsie.
Muitsexi 'ixaheritsixi yunaime kaniwarukuxeɨrieni, hikɨ mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe:
«Xeme xekaniuneniere Yawé kemɨtiuyuri 'Ekipitu Parahuni meta 'iparewiwamete wahɨxie meta naitsarie mɨkɨ kwieyaritsie kemɨtiuyuri.
Xekaniuneniere waɨkawamekɨ kemɨxetiuta'inɨataxɨ, 'inɨarite mamariwaweme kemɨtiuwewi.
Peru 'anapaitɨtɨ meta hikɨ Yawé xemeuta'iyaritawawenikɨ pɨkaxepitɨawe xemeti'enatɨkɨkanikɨ, meta hɨxite xemeunenierenikɨ, meta nakate xemeu'enanakakɨ.
Huta tewiyari wiyari tsepa nemɨxe'uwitɨximekai makuwakitsie, xe'ixuriki xekakai pɨka'utitsanixɨ.
Paa xepɨka'utikwai meta kaxie winuyari xepɨkahanu'i meta nitixaɨtɨ kwaniyariekame. 'Ikɨ mɨpaɨ nepɨtiuyuri mɨpaɨ xemɨtemaikakɨ kename ne Yawé xekakaɨyari nehɨkɨ.
»Kepauka 'ena temu'axɨa, Tsikuni ti'aitame payetɨa, Hetsiwuni kwieyaritsie kiekame meta 'Uhuki mɨtitewakai, Watsani kwieyaritsie ti'aitame, mana mepɨtatsi'utakwi, peru tame tepɨwara'iwaxɨ.
Naime wakwie tepɨwarunawairi tepɨwayetuiri Xuweni meta Kahari wanuiwarima meta hixɨata me'akame Manatsexi nuiwarimama, mɨkɨ wapiini mɨrayanikɨ.
»Hikɨta, yaxeketenekakɨni 'ikɨ tɨratu kemaine xeyukweriwayurietɨ, 'uxa'atɨniwarie 'aixɨa xemɨ'itɨariekakɨ tsepa kexemɨteyurie.
Hikɨ Yawé xekakaɨyari hɨxie xepɨku'u xeme xeyunaitɨ, xehɨxie memanuyetei, 'ukirawetsixi meta yunaitɨ 'ukitsi 'ixaheritsixi,
meta xeniwema meyunaitɨ xe'ɨitama meta 'ateewa kiekatari xekie memukutei, meta kɨ'ewemete meta hanɨwemete.
'Ena xepɨyuxeɨrie xeme xeyunaitɨ hikɨ tɨratu xemɨwewienikɨ Yawé xekakaɨyari hamatɨa, hikɨ miwewie xehamatɨa, meta mitseyuma yuhɨritɨatɨ yamɨtikayanikɨ.
'Ayumieme mɨkɨkɨ mɨpaɨ paine kename xeme xeteɨterimama, mɨkɨta kename xekakaɨyari hɨkɨ, xetutsima 'Apɨrahami, 'Itsahaki meta Kakuwu kemɨtiwarutahɨawixi.
Yawé takakaɨyari mɨpaɨ paine yurikɨ, kename tahamatɨa xeikɨa ka'iwewie yutɨratu meta kemɨtiyuhɨritɨa, 'ena hikɨ hɨxiena temuku'u,
matsi kemɨ'ane hikɨ tahamatɨa memɨka'u'uwa wahamatɨata kaniwewieka.
»Xeme xekatenakumaika 'Ekipitu ketemɨte'u'uwakai, meta huyeta ketemɨte'uhukai hipame nuiwarite watsata, mɨya tete'uhutɨ 'ena temu'axɨa.
Xeme xekaniwaruxeiya mɨkɨ watsata kakaɨyarixi memɨxani'eriwa kɨyexikɨ memɨwewiyatɨka, tetexikɨ, pɨratakɨ meta hurukɨ.

Xekeneyu'ɨwiya hikɨ xewitɨ kapa 'uki meta 'uka, meta xeinuiwari, meta xeixiɨyaritsixi hikɨ xe'iyari Yawé takakaɨyari 'uku'eirienikɨ, kapa hipame pɨta kakaɨyarixi mɨkɨ nuiwarite memuwarayexeiya warayexeiyatɨ 'ayanikɨ. Xekeneyukweriwayurieka kapa xewitɨ xeme naana mɨmɨya meta matsiwi hepaɨ 'ɨyɨnikɨ.
»Xɨka xewitɨ xeme, timaitɨtɨtɨ 'ikɨ niuki kemaine, xɨka 'aixɨa tiuyeikame yu'erieka, mɨpaɨ tiku'eriwani: “'Atsinepɨkayɨni, tsepa ne yanemɨtiyuriene kemɨnetinake”, mɨkɨ tiyurieyu yunaitɨ xepɨka'une.

Mɨkɨ Yawé pɨkareiyehɨwirieni. Kakaɨyari haxɨaya meta 'ɨtetsarikaya hetsiena kaniye'amɨkɨ. Naitɨ 'axamɨti'ane 'ikɨ xapatsie maye'uxa hetsiena katininakimɨkɨ, Yawé yapɨtiyurieni memɨkumawerekɨ yunaitɨ nuiwarimama.
Yawé penayehɨani 'Ixaheri nuiwarimama watsata, hetsiena pɨtinake naitɨ 'ikɨ kemɨre'uxa 'axakemɨ'itɨarienikɨ hepaɨtsita, tɨratu kemɨreku'uxa 'inɨari niukiyari xapayaritsie.
»Xeniwema meta xenuiwarima 'arike miemete, meta 'ateewa kiekatari memɨ'axɨani, mɨkɨ mepɨneniere kememɨtekwine meta kwiniya wahetsie kemɨtinake Yawé mɨwapitɨani 'ena kwiepa.

Mɨkɨ naitɨ pɨreuyeweni 'una pɨhɨkɨtɨni wakwie hatsiwitɨ 'u'ekatɨ, mana muyeikani pɨkayɨweni, mana mɨtiuka'eni pɨkayɨweni, mana mɨtitiwere pɨkayɨweni, meta tupiriya tɨma pɨkatineni. Kemɨtiɨyɨ kepauka Yawé mɨwaruka'unaxɨ Tsuruma kiekariyari meta Kumuxa, 'Arimaha meta Tsewuhini.
Yunaitɨ nuiwarite kwiepa memɨtama mɨpaɨ mepɨteta'iwauni: “¿Titayari Yawé 'ikɨ kwie mɨyatiuyuri? ¿Titayari yuhaxɨa waɨkawa mana tiukawiwi?”
'Ana mɨpaɨ mepɨtetahɨawarieni: “'Ikɨ teɨteri memiku'eirikɨ tɨratu Yawé miwewiekai wahamatɨa kepauka 'Ekipitu mɨwarayewitɨtsie.
Mekanekɨne, hipame pɨta kakaɨyarixi mewarayexeiyatɨ mekanakɨne, hipame kakaɨyarixi memɨkawamatekai wahɨxie mepukahɨxima'ui, mɨkaheuyewekai mɨkɨ kakaɨyarixi nenewieri memɨwapitɨakakɨ.
'Ayumieme Yawé waɨkawa kaniuyeha'ani 'ikɨ kwieyaritsie mieme, hikɨ mana kanikaxɨrieni naime kemɨre'uxa 'ikɨ xapayaritsie ke'axamu'itɨarienikɨ.
Merikɨte hikɨ ketemɨteneniere, Yawé waɨkawa ha'atɨ wakwiepa wananari naime kanahuna, xaɨtsie kaniwarexɨrieni xeime kwieyaritsie”.
»Tita mɨti'awietsie Yawé takakaɨyari hetsie katinimiemetɨni, matsi tita mɨtiutahekɨatsie tame pɨtahetsiemieme meta taniwema yuheyemekɨ, yatemɨtekahunikɨ 'ikɨ naime 'aitsika niukiyaritsie.
